package.name: rosbot_mavlink_bridge
package.description: Bridge node that translates the firmware's MAVLink wire protocol into the same ROS 2 API the micro-ROS agent currently exposes, so downstream consumers (e.g. rosbot_ros) see byte-identical topics/services. Single source tree builds for both jazzy and humble (see MAVLINK_MIGRATION.md D24).
package.author: Rafal Gorecki
